items_resolved.title: control_center_search N+1 BFS → frontier-level batch BFS
items_resolved.description: Replaced per-node entity_neighbors_v2() N+1 pattern in SqliteGraphStore::neighbors() with batch_neighbors_v2() that issues one SQL query per hop level using a dynamic IN(?,?,...) clause. The root cause of the 427ms control_center_search regression was O(F^D) SQL queries per traversal; the fix reduces this to O(D) queries (one per hop depth). Root cause documented in evidence/F5/run-001/reports/analytics-architecture-review.json.

items_resolved.title: authorize_read structural gate wired into MemorySystem::search
items_resolved.description: MemorySystem::search() now calls authorize_read() before any query planning, counts, ranking, serialization, or caching. This resolves the NBW-F1-03 structural gap where read_authorization::authorize_read was implemented but called from zero production read paths. For the current single-user single-partition deployment the gate always grants (SourceTrust::System, ReadCore capability); the AuthorizedScope is returned and available for F3/F4 to compose into SQL WHERE clauses. The existing ScopeFilter in Retriever provides defense-in-depth for the legacy path.
